description: [CHECK · internal] THE GATE KERNEL — the law you keep here, in one call. The five moves (find, distinguish the KIND, verify what can be verified, preserve the trail, never silently upgrade authority), the eight-rule agent covenant, the six object KINDS, the authority lattice (quarantined < cited < verified), and the nine-field gate record. Read it before you write; a system error is never a false verdict, and only a witnessed, evidenced gate reaches 'verified'.
